speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: Automating validation is a good start, but it does not fix the serving latency that keeps us missing the morning order window. We need the full pipeline to run in time so stores do not fall back to last week's numbers.
output.correction: I am not just talking about catching bad data before it hits the model. I am talking about the end to end reliability of the forecast service during the narrow ordering window.
